reference: REF 01 · candidate standard · ca747d8 physical evidence
scope: Configuration Atlas plus source-specific local runner; Atlas drafts never authorize hardware changes.

controls.title: Windows source endpoint
controls.detail: MM-1 is the preserved listening comparison. The authenticated product host supports exact-endpoint WASAPI and committed PCM, with runtime driver/period/geometry gates. No automatic routing.

controls.title: Source sample rate
controls.detail: Reference capture is 48 kHz; other source rates require an actual conversion and format-negotiation path.

controls.title: Source channel layout
controls.detail: Stereo PCM16 is the established wire format. Other layouts are not yet on the tested path.

controls.title: Capture PCM representation
controls.detail: 48 kHz stereo PCM16 is tested. Any other wire format needs compatible sender/receiver changes.

controls.title: WASAPI capture period
controls.detail: Actual capture period depends on selected render endpoint; current path uses WASAPI event-driven loopback.

controls.title: WASAPI engine buffer capacity
controls.detail: Configured 200 ms capacity is not necessarily 200 ms measured latency. Reducing requires evidence.

controls.title: WASAPI capture MMCSS
controls.detail: Best-effort Windows Audio scheduling is already requested in capture code.

controls.title: Silence/idle policy
controls.detail: No synthetic source clock is currently added during idle WASAPI activity.

controls.title: Dedicated audio endpoint path
controls.detail: Separate architecture work; needs explicit audio routing and driver/broker provisioning safeguards.

controls.title: Microphone input choice
controls.detail: For microphone uplink; permission and echo-control contracts are required.

controls.title: Original-packet QPC provenance
controls.detail: Existing v2 source metadata protects packet-time decisions; should remain invariant.

controls.title: Native source drop counter
controls.detail: Existing capture logs report native bounded-writer drops, not a measured acoustic delay.

controls.title: Corrected Windows driver timing identity
controls.detail: Minimum-period execution requires identified installed driver with corrected fractional WaveRT frame clock and late-notification behavior, not just an advertised processing period.

controls.title: Dedicated endpoint activation status
controls.detail: Authenticated enrollment, registry-derived identity and session-pinned QUIC are implemented. Lab uses the existing product host, verifies matching artifacts and records the actual endpoint. Physical qualification is outstanding.

controls.title: Own-endpoint source backend
controls.detail: Implemented backends selected at product session launch. Compare recorded exact endpoint identity, actual period, format and workload. Minimum and committed operation require native running-driver checks, never receipt-only approval.

controls.title: WaveRT export handoff ownership
controls.detail: Implemented immutable section-backed commit export with reserved/in-flight frame credits, revoke/rundown and acknowledgement ownership. Fixed developer limit; no Lab slider changes kernel credits.

controls.title: PCM commit-to-sender availability delta
controls.detail: Require correlated QPC commit/publication/sender-ready times, rather than assuming source request timestamps or device playback times measure sample availability.

controls.title: Direct-source freshness and recovery policy
controls.detail: Both implemented source adapters preserve their original provenance. Direct source retains commit QPC, source generations, 60ms age and accepted-commit recovery fences. No stale PCM restamping.

controls.title: Capture handoff transport
controls.detail: Present writer and pipe remain even after mutex-free native SPSC capture queue.

controls.title: Native capture queue slots
controls.detail: 8 × 5 ms = 40 ms storage ceiling; capacity is not measured queued delay.

controls.title: Rust pipe-reader channel
controls.detail: Second bounded 8-slot queue; no runtime setter is exposed.

controls.title: Wake/coalescing policy
controls.detail: Current Rust reader sends a local wake datagram on each accepted block.

controls.title: Pipe writer scheduling
controls.detail: Do not give writers blanket real-time priority; scoped policy requires load evidence.

controls.title: Rust reader scheduling
controls.detail: Thread-local MMCSS RAII is a possible source-stall improvement, not proven.

controls.title: QUIC owner scheduling
controls.detail: Only adopt if scheduling delays are established from counters.

controls.title: Handoff full policy
controls.detail: Preserve source identity and bounded latency; this is not an arbitrary unbounded queue.

controls.title: Hot-path logging policy
controls.detail: Current candidate defers owner/reader hot-path diagnostics until after streaming.

controls.title: IPC packet provenance
controls.detail: Maintain source-frame and original QPC membership across boundaries.

controls.title: PCM packet duration
controls.detail: 5 ms/240 frames is the verified wire format. Changing requires compatible packetization.

controls.title: Transport security
controls.detail: Not user-disableable. Authentication and source integrity are hard constraints.

controls.title: Transport mode
controls.detail: Current real-time PCM travels through QUIC DATAGRAM, not reliable retransmission.

controls.title: Maximum original-source age
controls.detail: Present default is a hard 60 ms sender age bound; not a live knob.

controls.title: Expire queued QUIC plaintext
controls.detail: Disabling freshness would permit stale audio; deliberately no unsafe toggle.

controls.title: QUIC pacing mode
controls.detail: No second audio clock or fabricated send timer; QUIC owns pacing correctness.

controls.title: Congestion policy
controls.detail: Choose only if transport stack supports it; no latency guarantees.

controls.title: Packet prioritization
controls.detail: Markings may be ignored or rewritten by home routers and mobile carriers.

controls.title: Max send burst
controls.detail: Example planning value only; current QUIC send behavior is managed by its reactor.

controls.title: Receiver reorder budget
controls.detail: Native candidate already includes bounded source-indexed reordering; enlarging capacity is not justified by prior tests.

controls.title: Forward error correction
controls.detail: FEC may increase resilience at a bandwidth and implementation cost; no production code present.

controls.title: Late repair policy
controls.detail: Never play late audio simply because retransmission succeeded.

controls.title: RTP/QUIC arrival jitter
controls.detail: Requires sampling arrival intervals from the real receiver; an estimated chart must not stand in for telemetry.

controls.title: Packet/source gap identity
controls.detail: Distinguish source holes from network loss and intentionally retired packets.

controls.title: AAudio buffer policy
controls.detail: Physical runner supports 0/2/3 at next launch. Default 0 produced an uninterrupted 30 s reference; 3 bursts worsened continuity.

controls.title: AAudio performance request
controls.detail: Requested low latency did NOT establish the negotiated route; observed Xiaomi backend reported NONE/SHARED.

controls.title: AAudio sharing mode
controls.detail: Requires reopening; exclusive path existence must be negotiated on the actual Xiaomi.

controls.title: AAudio usage category
controls.detail: Builder classification might influence route selection; not supported in existing runner.

controls.title: Output device/route
controls.detail: Different devices/routes have different HAL and hardware latencies; Bluetooth is not equivalent to speaker.

controls.title: Actual hardware burst size
controls.detail: Observed route characteristic, not a user-chosen value.

controls.title: Actual buffer size/capacity
controls.detail: Capacity/size observation ≠ 85.5 ms acoustic or end-to-end latency.

controls.title: Negotiated output backend
controls.detail: Low-latency was requested, but negotiated performance mode was NONE in previous Xiaomi traces.

controls.title: AAudio hardware X-runs
controls.detail: Zero hardware X-runs can coexist with native-app silence during starvation.

controls.title: Dynamic hardware buffer adaptation
controls.detail: Possible runtime size adjustment via Android API subject to bounds; adaptive policy is not implemented.

controls.title: Exclusive route fallback
controls.detail: Only relevant if exclusive mode is requested; no claim that Xiaomi provides it.

controls.title: AAudio callback demand
controls.detail: Priming must account for callback demand, not only reserve frames.

controls.title: 128-tap sinc renderer
controls.detail: Real runner supports on/off at next test session. Bypass is NOT linear interpolation.

controls.title: Resampler filter length
controls.detail: 128-tap finite-support table is implemented; changing support demands carefully rebuilt DSP and phase qualification.

controls.title: Sinc interpolation phases
controls.detail: Current table uses 1024 phases. Alternatives not qualified.

controls.title: Drift correction bound
controls.detail: Current ±400 ppm. Exposing it as a live knob requires an atomic config contract.

controls.title: Maximum drift slew
controls.detail: Current 100 ppm/s. Faster adaptation may cause audible modulation.

controls.title: Drift controller time constant
controls.detail: Current time-based controller filter ~1 s; change only after measured convergence/drift tests.

controls.title: Native post-callback reserve
controls.detail: Established reference: 1,440 frames after callback demand. This is not total buffer occupancy.

controls.title: Priming threshold policy
controls.detail: The callback-demand correction was necessary: fixed 30 ms before callback caused starvation.

controls.title: Short fades
controls.detail: Live physical runner supports ON/OFF at test start, not a mid-callback change.

controls.title: Fade length
controls.detail: Current 96 frames (2 ms). A longer fade is not a cure for sustained starvation.

controls.title: Short-gap concealment
controls.detail: Can be toggled between physical sessions. Defined silence is not lossless concealment.

controls.title: Max concealed interval
controls.detail: Existing cap is 480 frames/10 ms, only for eligible aligned gaps.

controls.title: Authenticated recovery mode
controls.detail: Auth and source frontier must remain enforced. Do not treat a reanchor count as network loss.

controls.title: Recovery timeout budget
controls.detail: 120-second session previously failed on anchor timeout. Changing bound is not a substitute for diagnosing root cause.

controls.title: Native callback underruns
controls.detail: This metric is more informative about native starvation than device X-runs alone.

controls.title: PCM16 clipping/saturation
controls.detail: Native reconstruction includes explicit clipping accounting.

controls.title: Access network
controls.detail: Cellular and WAN are future physical qualification targets. Local Wi-Fi is current lab context.

controls.title: Network round-trip time
controls.detail: Planning scenario input only. Measured RTT must come from actual per-path telemetry.

controls.title: Arrival jitter envelope
controls.detail: What-if assumption, not a measurement or a target buffer recommendation.

controls.title: Random burst loss scenario
controls.detail: Planning input only; real burst-loss behavior differs from uniform percentage.

controls.title: Network handover handling
controls.detail: Resume strategy for Wi-Fi-to-cellular route changes; preserve authenticated identity.

controls.title: Multipath transport
controls.detail: Expensive, battery-intensive feature requiring actual path management.

controls.title: Relay / NAT traversal
controls.detail: Relay may be necessary across carriers; private credentials and authentication remain required.

controls.title: Network bitrate budget
controls.detail: Exploratory bandwidth budget; existing audio path is uncompressed PCM at about 1.536 Mb/s payload.

controls.title: Metered-data preference
controls.detail: Requires separate traffic accounting; does not make PCM cost-free.

controls.title: Idle keepalive policy
controls.detail: Must respect NAT/carrier connection timeouts and protocol activity.

controls.title: FEC redundancy budget
controls.detail: No FEC implementation yet; value only in planned profile.

controls.title: Congestion response bias
controls.detail: Requires explicit policy translating bias to compatible transport controls.

controls.title: Cellular path evidence
controls.detail: Later: RTT, loss burst, carrier type, active link and path migration logs.

controls.title: Radio/battery impact
controls.detail: Later: duty cycle, modem data use and battery cost; avoid guessed power savings.

controls.title: Video source
controls.detail: Per-window native phone-oriented presentation remains DeskFuse core. Browser offscreen avoids full-desktop capture when suitable.

controls.title: Video frame rate
controls.detail: Future video pipeline; display refresh and decoder support must be negotiated.

controls.title: Output spatial resolution
controls.detail: Device-pixel ratio and individual-window shape are independent of virtual monitor pixel size.

controls.title: Video codec
controls.detail: Codec availability and encoding delay must be measured on actual devices.

controls.title: Video encoder route
controls.detail: Hardware access differs between Windows GPUs and Android devices.

controls.title: B-frame reordering
controls.detail: For interactive streaming, reordering can add frame delay; useful quality comparator.

controls.title: Keyframe interval
controls.detail: Shorter intervals aid recovery but increase bitrate and encoder load.

controls.title: Video bitrate target
controls.detail: Rate control depends on resolution, codec and connection.

controls.title: Video quality target
controls.detail: A conceptual normalized profile value, not a codec QP.

controls.title: Video rate control
controls.detail: Requires real encoding backend and stats to be meaningful.

controls.title: Phone layout pixel ratio
controls.detail: Web/window layout can be rendered offscreen at phone-specific DIP geometry.

controls.title: Color / HDR pipeline
controls.detail: Only expose HDR for a verified capture-to-display metadata path.

controls.title: Decoded-frame queue
controls.detail: Bounded display queue; never grow indefinitely during congestion.

controls.title: Display presentation policy
controls.detail: Important for interaction; display timing differs from audio output clock.

controls.title: Late-frame handling
controls.detail: For game control prioritize fresh images over out-of-date frames.

controls.title: A/V synchronization master
controls.detail: For one-way audio/video, audio generally provides a stable presentation timebase; design requires cross-clock alignment.

controls.title: User A/V offset
controls.detail: User-adjustable perceptual offset; applied live only after timestamp and renderer support.

controls.title: Lip-sync tolerance
controls.detail: Different content types have different tolerances.

controls.title: Video catch-up rule
controls.detail: Do not silently stretch audio without a qualified DSP operation.

controls.title: Windows/Android clock mapping
controls.detail: Current QPC and AAudio times cannot be directly subtracted without synchronized mapping.

controls.title: Physical A/V latency calibration
controls.detail: Need independent physical timing evidence. Nominal HAL pending frames are not acoustic latency.

controls.title: Orientation transitions
controls.detail: Avoid unnecessary audio interruption on phone orientation changes.

controls.title: Display scanout mode
controls.detail: Panel, compositor and decoder impose route-dependent latency.

controls.title: Session direction
controls.detail: Current physical runner supports only PC → Xiaomi playback.

controls.title: Capture uplink
controls.detail: Permission scope and user indicator should be explicit.

controls.title: Local sidetone level
controls.detail: Headphone/speaker feedback conditions matter; not suitable as uncontrolled echo source.

controls.title: Acoustic echo cancellation
controls.detail: Necessary for speakerphone talkback; can trade fidelity and CPU for echo suppression.

controls.title: Noise suppression
controls.detail: User-tunable tradeoff for speech capture; keep music mode unprocessed.

controls.title: Duck remote audio while speaking
controls.detail: Optional communication policy, separate from stream transport.

controls.title: Voice uplink codec
controls.detail: Opus is proposed only; no production end-to-end uplink path in the current lab.

controls.title: Remote/local mix policy
controls.detail: Future configurable mixing; maintain each stream’s source identity.

controls.title: Push-to-talk mode
controls.detail: Voice activation needs privacy controls and false-trigger handling.

controls.title: Duplex jitter budget
controls.detail: Separate jitter budgets per direction, never a single magical round-trip buffer.

controls.title: Feedback loop prevention
controls.detail: Prevent recording remote output back into the return stream.

controls.title: Round-trip talkback latency
controls.detail: Needs physical calibrated loopback, not two unsynchronized software timestamps.

controls.title: Session topology
controls.detail: Native audio stack is currently PC-to-phone only.

controls.title: Peer discovery
controls.detail: Peer discovery requires authenticated pairing and appropriate network boundaries.

controls.title: NAT traversal
controls.detail: Cellular CGNAT often rules out simple inbound direct connectivity.

controls.title: Number of receivers
controls.detail: Requires independent receiver clocks and per-peer congestion control.

controls.title: Per-peer quality
controls.detail: A slow receiver should not force everyone else to share its queue.

controls.title: Sender/receiver role handoff
controls.detail: Avoid implicit microphone/camera activation on role changes.

controls.title: Multi-device audio mixing
controls.detail: Mixing clock domains needs timebase and drift coordination.

controls.title: Peer clock authority
controls.detail: A multi-device session cannot assume all output clocks advance identically.

controls.title: Per-peer authenticated encryption
controls.detail: Future protocols must retain secure peer identity and authenticated media.

controls.title: Remote-control permission
controls.detail: Separate streaming access from remote input privileges.

controls.title: Congestion fairness mode
controls.detail: No claim that one QUIC connection can simply be cloned to multiple clients.

controls.title: Mesh peer forwarding
controls.detail: Avoid a naive always-on multi-hop overlay with uncontrolled battery cost.

controls.title: User performance preset
controls.detail: User-facing presets should be grounded in hardware-specific evidence, not pretend to be qualified.

controls.title: Automatic tuning
controls.detail: Automatic policies require reliable actual counters, guardrails and rollback.

controls.title: Network condition selector
controls.detail: Scenario classification for experimentation, not a replacement for measurement.

controls.title: Optimization objective
controls.detail: Goals are multi-objective; never pretend one master slider can optimize them all.

controls.title: Underrun guardrail
controls.detail: Example policy threshold only; no auto-tuning agent is implemented.

controls.title: Automatic rollback
controls.detail: A future auto system must store prior working profiles and rollback on worsening audio.

controls.title: One-factor test discipline
controls.detail: Exploratory planning can be broad; physical comparative trials should change one factor initially.

controls.title: Profile portability
controls.detail: Future presets should include platform identity, app version and feature availability.

controls.title: Per-device profile policy
controls.detail: Hardware routes differ; a Xiaomi speaker buffer should not be assumed portable to Bluetooth or another phone.

controls.title: User data/power policy
controls.detail: The lab can model constraints now; enforcing them requires platform capabilities.

controls.title: Remote configuration approval
controls.detail: Remote controls need capability/authorization boundaries.

controls.title: Profile versioned history
controls.detail: Use export/import today; future experiments need hardware/binary hashes for reproducibility.

controls.title: Subjective listening note
controls.detail: Record audible gaps, perceived delay, content and route separately from model estimates.

controls.title: Measured speaker-to-phone lag
controls.detail: Requires common acoustic timebase or single recorder; AAudio output queue estimates are not acoustic delay.

controls.title: AAudio negotiated route state
controls.detail: Report sharing, performance, frames per burst and actual buffer size from real runs.

controls.title: Binary/source identity receipt
controls.detail: Lab bridge verifies matched Release binaries and tested checkout before starting.

controls.title: Per-session energy usage
controls.detail: Compare battery drain with thermal state and screen brightness held comparable.

controls.title: A/V synchronization error
controls.detail: Needs synchronized video/audio presentation markers.

controls.title: Per-path packet/RTT metrics
controls.detail: Explicitly label network loss separately from capture gaps and retired source positions.

controls.title: Resampler fidelity qualification
controls.detail: No automatic high-fidelity score from the selected algorithm alone.

controls.title: Captured audio handling
controls.detail: Local lab does not upload captured audio; opt-in evidence must respect private content.

controls.title: Protocol and identity guards
controls.detail: Never expose disabling QUIC auth, source identity or checked recovery as a user convenience.

controls.title: Runtime trace detail
controls.detail: Keep expensive synchronous per-packet logging off deadline-bearing threads.

controls.title: Physical qualification duration
controls.detail: 30 sec has a clean reference; longer sustained runs are not yet qualified.

controls.title: Explicit safe receiver re-prime
controls.detail: Future operator request: retire current output generation and obtain authenticated fresh-source anchor. Not a mute/unmute shortcut.

controls.title: Reserve change on next re-prime
controls.detail: Future re-prime transaction must change post-callback reserve atomically; code currently fixes 1,440 frames.

controls.title: DSP mode transition boundary
controls.detail: A qualified filter switch must re-establish sinc history, phase and source identity; not a mid-sample toggle.

controls.title: Recovery trigger policy
controls.detail: Future tuning of trigger thresholds must retain source frontier and avoid reanchor storms.

controls.title: A/V group re-synchronization
controls.detail: Potential frame-aligned resynchronization when audio recovery invalidates A/V presentation phase.

controls.title: Independent duplex-leg recovery
controls.detail: Future full-duplex receiver must be able to re-prime one direction without unnecessarily interrupting the other.
